title: Cost-effectiveness of respiratory syncytial virus vaccines in post-marketing settings: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
abstract: Abstract Background Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a leading cause of acute lower respiratory infections, hospitalizations, and deaths, particularly among infants and older adults worldwide. This study aims to summarize cost-effectiveness evidence by pooling incremental net benefit (INB) estimates of marketed RSV vaccines. Methods In this review, PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library were searched through November 20, 2025. Grey literature and reference lists were also searched. Random-effects meta-analyses were conducted separately for older adults and infants. Potential sources of heterogeneity were explored using population-specific subgroup analyses and univariable meta-regressions. Results Of the 17 studies included in the systematic review, 11 contributed to the primary meta-analysis and one additional study to sensitivity analysis only. Among older adults, the pooled INB was USD 105.05 [95% confidence interval ( CI ): USD 41.89–168.21; I 2 = 93.2%]. For infants, the pooled INB was USD 5.81 (95% CI: USD − 35.44–47.07; I 2 = 89.4%). In the European subgroup, the pooled INB among older adults was USD 123.63 (95% CI: USD 41.23–206.02; I 2 = 89.4%), while that for infants was USD 15.00 (95% CI: USD − 4.33–34.34; I 2 = 43.4%). Leave-one-out sensitivity analyses showed robust pooled INBs among older adults, whereas infant estimates were sensitive to study exclusion. Conclusions At the thresholds used in the included studies, RSV vaccination might be cost-effective for older adults in post-marketing settings, while the evidence for maternal vaccination remained inconclusive. Descriptive findings suggested that age- and risk-based targeting in older adults and seasonal maternal vaccination may yield higher INB estimates. Substantial between-study heterogeneity warrants cautious interpretation of the pooled estimates and highlights the need to consider local epidemiology and implementation conditions when developing RSV vaccination policies.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis assesses the cost-effectiveness of RSV vaccines in post-marketing settings, focusing on older adults and infants. The review pooled incremental net benefit (INB) estimates from 17 studies, with 11 contributing to the primary meta-analysis and one to sensitivity analysis. For older adults, the pooled INB was USD 105.05 (95% CI: USD 41.89–168.21; I2 = 93.2%), indicating potential cost-effectiveness. For infants, the pooled INB was USD 5.81 (95% CI: USD −35.44–47.07; I2 = 89.4%), with results being sensitive to study exclusion. The European subgroup showed higher INB for older adults (USD 123.63; 95% CI: USD 41.23–206.02; I2 = 89.4%) and moderate INB for infants (USD 15.00; 95% CI: USD −4.33–34.34; I2 = 43.4%). Sensitivity analyses revealed robust findings for older adults but variability for infants. The review emphasizes the importance of local epidemiology and implementation conditions in RSV vaccination policy development. Age- and risk-based targeting in older adults and seasonal maternal vaccination may enhance cost-effectiveness.

title_zh: 呼吸道合胞病毒 疫苗 在上市后环境中的成本效益:系统评价和荟萃分析。
source_body_en: Abstract Background Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is a leading cause of acute lower respiratory infections, hospitalizations, and deaths, particularly among infants and older adults worldwide. This study aims to summarize cost-effectiveness evidence by pooling incremental net benefit (INB) estimates of marketed RSV vaccines. Methods In this review, PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library were searched through November 20, 2025. Grey literature and reference lists were also searched. Random-effects meta-analyses were conducted separately for older adults and infants. Potential sources of heterogeneity were explored using population-specific subgroup analyses and univariable meta-regressions. Results Of the 17 studies included in the systematic review, 11 contributed to the primary meta-analysis and one additional study to sensitivity analysis only. Among older adults, the pooled INB was USD 105.05 [95% confidence interval ( CI ): USD 41.89–168.21; I 2 = 93.2%]. For infants, the pooled INB was USD 5.81 (95% CI: USD − 35.44–47.07; I 2 = 89.4%). In the European subgroup, the pooled INB among older adults was USD 123.63 (95% CI: USD 41.23–206.02; I 2 = 89.4%), while that for infants was USD 15.00 (95% CI: USD − 4.33–34.34; I 2 = 43.4%). Leave-one-out sensitivity analyses showed robust pooled INBs among older adults, whereas infant estimates were sensitive to study exclusion. Conclusions At the thresholds used in the included studies, RSV vaccination might be cost-effective for older adults in post-marketing settings, while the evidence for maternal vaccination remained inconclusive. Descriptive findings suggested that age- and risk-based targeting in older adults and seasonal maternal vaccination may yield higher INB estimates. Substantial between-study heterogeneity warrants cautious interpretation of the pooled estimates and highlights the need to consider local epidemiology and implementation conditions when developing RSV vaccination policies.
abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 是急性下呼吸道感染、住院和死亡的主要原因,特别是在全世界的婴儿和老年人中。本研究旨在通过汇总市售 RSV 疫苗 的增量净效益 (INB) 估计值来总结成本效益证据。方法 在这篇综述中,检索了截至 2025 年 11 月 20 日的 PubMed、Embase、Web of Science 和 Cochrane 图书馆。还检索了灰色文献和参考文献列表。分别对老年人和婴儿进行随机效应荟萃分析。使用特定人群的亚组分析和单变量元回归探讨了异质性的潜在来源。结果 在系统评价纳入的 17 项研究中,11 项参与了主要荟萃分析,另外一项研究仅参与了敏感性分析。在老年人中,汇总 INB 为 105.05 美元 [95% 置信区间 (CI):41.89–168.21 美元;I 2 = 93.2%]。对于婴儿,汇总 INB 为 5.81 美元(95% CI:USD − 35.44–47.07;I 2 = 89.4%)。在欧洲亚组中,老年人的汇总 INB 为 123.63 美元(95% CI:USD 41.23–206.02;I 2 = 89.4%),而婴儿的 INB 为 15.00 美元(95% CI:USD − 4.33–34.34;I 2 = 43.4%)。留一法敏感性分析显示,老年人中的汇总 INB 很稳健,而婴儿的估计值对研究排除很敏感。结论 在纳入研究中使用的阈值下,RSV 疫苗接种 对于上市后的老年人来说可能具有成本效益,而孕产妇 疫苗接种 的证据仍不确定。描述性研究结果表明,针对老年人和季节性母亲 疫苗接种 基于年龄和风险的目标可能会产生更高的 INB 估计值。研究间的显着异质性需要对汇总估计值进行谨慎解释,并强调在制定 RSV 流行病学 政策时需要考虑当地 流行病学 和实施条件。

title: RSV bronchiolitis admissions in infants immunized with nirsevimab: a multicenter observational study.
abstract: UNLABELLED: Real-world studies have confirmed the high effectiveness of nirsevimab, preventing approximately 80% of RSV bronchiolitis hospitalizations. This study aimed to evaluate the epidemiological and clinical characteristics of RSV bronchiolitis admissions following successful nationwide implementation of nirsevimab. We conducted a retrospective multicenter study across 15 Spanish pediatric emergency departments during the 2024-2025 RSV season. Infants eligible for the RSV prophylaxis, defined as those younger than six months at the start of or during the RSV season, with laboratory-confirmed RSV bronchiolitis requiring hospitalization were included. Patients immunized fewer than seven days before admission or with unknown immunization status were excluded. Epidemiological and clinical data were analyzed according to nirsevimab status, with age-stratified and multivariable analyses performed. Among 366 hospitalized infants with RSV bronchiolitis, 345 were previously healthy. Of these, 165/345 (47.8%) had received nirsevimab. Breakthrough cases were younger than non-breakthrough cases (2.0 months [IQR, 1.1-3.6] vs 5.2 months [IQR, 3.3-6.6]; p < 0.001). Overall, immunized and non-immunized infants showed similar rates of pediatric intensive care unit (PICU) admission (26.7% vs 21.1%; p = 0.2) and length of hospital stay (5 days [IQR, 3-7] vs 5 days [IQR, 4-7]; p = 0.6). After age stratification, clinical characteristics and outcomes remained comparable between groups. In multivariable analyses, no statistically significant association was observed between nirsevimab immunization and PICU admission, advanced respiratory support, or length of hospital stay. CONCLUSIONS: In-hospital outcomes of RSV bronchiolitis admissions did not differ significantly by immunization status. These findings suggest that, once hospitalization is required, nirsevimab may offer limited additional protection against severe disease. WHAT IS KNOWN: • Real-world studies have confirmed the high effectiveness of nirsevimab, preventing approximately 80% of RSV bronchiolitis hospitalizations. WHAT IS NEW: • In-hospital outcomes of RSV bronchiolitis admissions did not differ significantly by immunization status.

title: Enhanced respiratory syncytial virus surveillance of young children admitted to the Sydney Children's Hospitals Network, 2019-2023.
abstract: OBJECTIVES: In this study, we aimed to comprehensively describe the clinical characteristics, management and outcomes of children with respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) disease admitted to the Sydney Children's Hospitals Network (SCHN), determine the full burden of severe disease and identify population-specific risk factors for intensive care unit (ICU) admission. STUDY TYPE: Multi-centre, retrospective cohort study conducted over 5 years. METHODS: The study was conducted at two tertiary paediatric hospitals in metropolitan New South Wales, Australia, before implementation of government-funded immunisation programs against RSV in children. Participants were children aged <2 years hospitalised with laboratory-confirmed RSV from 1 January 2019 to 31 December 2023, comprising all ICU admitted, and a random sample of non-ICU admitted patients. The main outcome measures were characteristics and incidence rate of RSV hospitalisations and ICU admissions among children aged <2 years. RESULTS: Over a 5-year period, 4414 children were hospitalised with laboratory-confirmed RSV, of whom 11.3% (499/4414) were admitted to ICU. The median age was younger in the ICU cohort (n = 499) compared with the non-ICU sample (n = 1000; 3.3 vs 7.1 months, P < 0.0001). Factors associated with higher odds of ICU admission in multivariate logistic regression were decreasing month of age (OR 1.10, 95% CI 1.06-1.11), prematurity (OR 2.17, 95% CI 1.61-2.91), Indigenous identity (OR 4.10, 95% CI 2.30-7.56) and cardiac disease (OR 3.39, 95% CI 2.06-5.70). The average hospitalisation incidence rate was 1615 per 100,000 (95% CI 1565-1666), with higher rates among children aged <1 year, 2141 per 100,000 (95% CI 2061-2224) compared with those aged 1-2 years, 1088 per 100,000 (95% CI 1030-1148). CONCLUSIONS: RSV immunisation programs are expected to substantially reduce the burden of hospitalisation among Australian children in their first year of life. Children who are Indigenous, were born prematurely or have heart disease are at greatest risk of severe disease and may benefit from extended preventative programs.

title: Spatiotemporal dynamics of human metapneumovirus and potential impact of respiratory syncytial virus interventions in the United States.
abstract: Human metapneumovirus (HMPV) causes acute lower respiratory infections, primarily affecting young children and older adults, with seasonal outbreaks peaking annually in March or April in the United States and other temperate regions in the Northern hemisphere. However, the factors driving HMPV seasonality in the United States remain poorly understood. We analyzed laboratory-confirmed HMPV cases and age-specific emergency department visits across 10 US regions, fitting an age-stratified dynamic transmission model to assess spatiotemporal patterns and investigate the influence of environmental variables and viral interference from RSV on HMPV transmission rates. We found that models incorporating climate variables into the transmission rate, including vapor pressure, precipitation, potential evapotranspiration, and minimum temperature, could not capture the timing of HMPV activity across all regions. Instead, HMPV timing was associated with RSV activity, with the HMPV transmission rate reduced in the presence of RSV. We showed that among the candidate models considered, only the models that included an RSV-associated term could reproduce the biennial pattern of HMPV observed in some regions, characterized by alternating "late-small" and "early-large" epidemics. When the best-fit model including the RSV-associated term was used to predict the potential impact of RSV interventions on HMPV transmission, we found that RSV interventions are unlikely to result in a substantial increase in HMPV activity despite reducing competition from RSV. Our work unravels the spatiotemporal dynamics of HMPV and its interaction with RSV, informing future seasonal forecasting and intervention strategies for HMPV.

abstract_zh: 人类偏肺病毒 (HMPV) 会引起急性下呼吸道感染,主要影响幼儿和老年人,美国和北半球其他温带地区的季节性 暴发 高峰期为每年 3 月或 4 月。然而,人们对推动美国 HMPV 季节性的因素仍知之甚少。我们分析了美国 10 个地区的实验室确诊的 HMPV 病例和特定年龄的急诊科就诊情况,拟合了按年龄分层的动态 传播 模型,以评估时空模式,并研究环境变量和 RSV 病毒干扰对 HMPV 传播 发病率的影响。我们发现,将气候变量纳入 传播 速率(包括蒸气压、降水、潜在蒸散量和最低温度)的模型无法捕获所有地区 HMPV 活动的时间。相反,HMPV 时间与 RSV 活性相关,在 RSV 存在的情况下,HMPV 传播 率降低。我们表明,在考虑的候选模型中,只有包含 RSV 相关术语的模型才能重现在某些地区观察到的 HMPV 两年一次的模式,其特点是交替出现“晚期小规模”和“早期大规模”流行病。当使用包含 RSV 相关项的最佳拟合模型来预测 RSV 干预对 HMPV 传播 的潜在影响时,我们发现,尽管 RSV 的竞争减少,但 RSV 干预不太可能导致 HMPV 活性大幅增加。我们的工作揭示了 HMPV 的时空动态及其与 RSV 的相互作用,为未来的 HMPV 季节性预测和干预策略提供信息。

title: Beyond Croup: A Phenotype-Based Perspective on Parainfluenza Virus Types in Children.
abstract: Human parainfluenza viruses (PIVs) caused an estimated 18.8 million acute lower respiratory infection episodes, 725 000 hospitalizations, and 34 400 deaths among children under 5 in 2018, ranking second only to respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). Despite this burden, clinical attention has historically focused on croup, leading to the common perception that parainfluenza is a single disease entity. However, the 4 types differ substantially in taxonomy, tropism, clinical syndrome, and severity. PIV-1, the most common cause of croup, drives biennial epidemics in toddlers, whereas PIV-2 is less frequent but can cause severe disease, particularly in children with underlying conditions. PIV-3 predominates in young infants, causing bronchiolitis and pneumonia clinically like RSV infection, reflecting its early postnatal susceptibility, which may relate to earlier and more frequent viral exposure. PIV-4, historically underrecognized due to culture limitations, usually does not cause croup but is linked to lower respiratory tract disease, hypoxemia, and occasional neurologic complications. PIV infections are most severe in infants, immunocompromised children, and those in low-resource settings. Seasonal patterns vary by type and geography. Advances in multiplex molecular diagnostics now allow rapid type-specific detection, improving clinical interpretation and management. No vaccine or antiviral is licensed. Emerging therapeutics include sialidase-based antivirals with Food and Drug Administration Breakthrough designation; monoclonal antibodies capable of cross-neutralizing PIV-1, PIV-3, RSV, and human metapneumovirus; and messenger RNA vaccines showing early immunogenicity in children. Recognizing the distinct epidemiology, clinical features, and immune responses of each type is critical for informed pediatric care and the development of targeted preventive and therapeutic strategies.

analysis.scope_and_question: The review focuses on human parainfluenza viruses (PIVs) and their role in causing respiratory infections in children, with an emphasis on the distinct clinical and epidemiological characteristics of PIV types. The central question is whether PIVs should be considered as a single disease entity or as separate pathogens with unique impacts on pediatric health.
analysis.evidence_base_and_review_method: The review is a narrative synthesis of existing literature, with no explicit mention of systematic search methods, databases, or meta-analysis. It provides general background on PIVs and their clinical relevance, but does not report on study selection criteria or the number of studies included.
analysis.consensus_and_key_conclusions: The review concludes that the four PIV types differ significantly in taxonomy, tropism, clinical syndrome, and severity. It highlights that PIV-1 is the most common cause of croup, PIV-2 can cause severe disease in children with underlying conditions, PIV-3 is associated with bronchiolitis and pneumonia in young infants, and PIV-4 is linked to lower respiratory tract disease and occasional neurologic complications.
analysis.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: The review notes that PIV-4 has been historically underrecognized due to limitations in viral culture techniques. It also identifies gaps in understanding the full spectrum of clinical manifestations and the role of immune responses in varying disease severity across PIV types.
analysis.research_and_practice_implications: The review emphasizes the need for improved diagnostic tools, such as multiplex molecular diagnostics, to better identify PIV types and guide clinical management. It also suggests the importance of developing targeted preventive and therapeutic strategies, as no vaccine or antiviral is currently licensed for PIV infections.

analysis.summary_en: This review provides a phenotype-based perspective on human parainfluenza viruses (PIVs) in children, highlighting their distinct epidemiology, clinical features, and immune responses. It underscores the limitations of focusing solely on croup as a clinical manifestation and calls for a more nuanced understanding of PIV types. The review notes that PIV-1 drives biennial epidemics, PIV-2 can cause severe disease in vulnerable children, PIV-3 is associated with bronchiolitis and pneumonia in infants, and PIV-4 is linked to lower respiratory tract disease and rare neurologic complications. Despite the burden of PIV infections, no licensed vaccines or antivirals are available, and emerging therapies show promise. The authors stress the importance of recognizing these differences for improved pediatric care and the development of targeted interventions.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 该综述的重点是人类副流感病毒 (PIV) 及其在引起儿童呼吸道感染中的作用,重点是 PIV 类型的独特临床和流行病学特征。核心问题是 PIV 是否应被视为单一疾病实体,还是对儿科健康具有独特影响的单独病原体。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述是对现有文献的叙述性综合,没有明确提及系统搜索方法、数据库或荟萃分析。它提供了 PIV 的一般背景及其临床相关性,但没有报告研究选择标准或纳入的研究数量。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 审查得出的结论是,四种 PIV 类型在分类、向性、临床综合征和严重程度方面存在显着差异。报告强调,PIV-1 是哮吼最常见的病因,PIV-2 可在患有基础疾病的儿童中引起严重疾病,PIV-3 与 毛细支气管炎 和小婴儿肺炎相关,PIV-4 与下呼吸道疾病和偶尔的神经系统并发症相关。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该评论指出,由于病毒培养技术的限制,PIV-4 在历史上一直未被充分认识。它还确定了在理解全谱临床表现以及 免疫应答 在不同 PIV 类型的不同疾病严重程度中的作用方面的差距。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述强调需要改进诊断工具,例如多重分子诊断,以更好地识别 PIV 类型并指导临床管理。它还表明制定有针对性的预防和治疗策略的重要性,因为目前没有 疫苗 或 抗病毒药物 获得用于 PIV 感染的许可。

analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该综述是对现有文献的叙述性综合,没有明确提及系统搜索方法、数据库或荟萃分析。它提供了 PIV 的一般背景及其临床相关性,但没有报告研究选择标准或纳入的研究数量。
analysis_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 审查得出的结论是,四种 PIV 类型在分类、向性、临床综合征和严重程度方面存在显着差异。报告强调,PIV-1 是哮吼最常见的病因,PIV-2 可在患有基础疾病的儿童中引起严重疾病,PIV-3 与 毛细支气管炎 和小婴儿肺炎相关,PIV-4 与下呼吸道疾病和偶尔的神经系统并发症相关。
analysis_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该评论指出,由于病毒培养技术的限制,PIV-4 在历史上一直未被充分认识。它还确定了在理解全谱临床表现以及 免疫应答 在不同 PIV 类型的不同疾病严重程度中的作用方面的差距。
analysis_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述强调需要改进诊断工具,例如多重分子诊断,以更好地识别 PIV 类型并指导临床管理。它还表明制定有针对性的预防和治疗策略的重要性,因为目前没有 疫苗 或 抗病毒药物 获得用于 PIV 感染的许可。

title: Generative AI-Designed Immunoglobulin Domain Antibodies (IgDAbs) Against the Fusion Protein as a Neutralizing Agent for Respiratory Syncytial Virus.
abstract: OBJECTIVE: This study aimed to rationally design, screen, and experimentally validate novel immunoglobulin domain antibodies (IgDAbs) targeting the site II epitope of the respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) fusion (F) protein using generative artificial intelligence (GenAI) driven tools. METHOD: A generative AI tool was employed to generate 250 novel IgDAb sequences optimized for RSV-F site II binding. Candidates were screened computationally using molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations to select hit candidates. The selected IgDAbs were cloned and produced using an E. coli expression system. Purified IgDAbs were characterized for target specificity via ELISA and evaluated for functional viral inhibition using in vitro microneutralization assay against RSV A2 (long strain). RESULT: Computational screening narrowed the library to 05 structurally compatible hit IgDAb with predicted binding affinity. ELISA confirmed specific binding of purified IgDAbs to the RSV-F protein. In vitro microneutralization assays demonstrated neutralization of RSV A2 (long strain), with two 'lead' IgDAbs showing EC50 of 1.3 μg/mL and 3.5 μg/mL. CONCLUSION: Combining generative AI sequence generation with an integrated in silico and in vitro screening cascade enables the rapid, cost-effective discovery of neutralizing nanobodies against RSV, offering a viable alternative to resource-intensive traditional antibody discovery workflows.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在使用生成人工智能 (GenAI) 驱动工具,合理设计、筛选和实验验证针对 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 融合 (F) 蛋白的位点 II 表位的新型免疫球蛋白域抗体 (IgDAb)。科学/公共卫生问题是需要有效且具有成本效益的方法来发现针对RSV的中和抗体,RSV会导致严重的呼吸道感染。知识差距在于缺乏快速且经济有效的方法来发现此类抗体。其基本原理是利用 GenAI 来加速发现过程。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 采用生成式 AI 工具生成 250 个针对 RSV-F 位点 II 结合进行优化的新型 IgDAb 序列。使用分子对接和分子动力学模拟对候选物进行计算筛选,以选择命中候选物。研究设计涉及使用大肠杆菌表达系统来生产和纯化选定的 IgDAb。该群体包括用于体外微量中和测定的 RSV-A2(长株)。
elements_zh.methods: 使用大肠杆菌表达系统克隆并产生选定的 IgDAb。通过 ELISA 表征纯化的 IgDAb 的靶标特异性,并使用针对 RSV A2(长株)的体外微中和测定评估功能性病毒抑制。
elements_zh.main_results: 计算筛选将文库缩小到 05 个结构兼容且具有预测结合亲和力的命中 IgDAb。ELISA 证实了纯化的 IgDAb 与 RSV-F 蛋白的特异性结合。体外微中和试验表明,两种“先导”IgDAb 可中和 RSV A2(长株),其 EC50 分别为 1.3 μg/mL 和 3.5 μg/mL。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 将生成式 AI 序列生成与集成的计算机和体外筛选级联相结合,能够快速、经济高效地发现针对 RSV 的中和纳米抗体,为资源密集型的传统抗体发现工作流程提供了可行的替代方案。新颖之处在于使用 GenAI 来加速发现过程。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为 RSV 的新治疗策略的开发提供信息,RSV 是一个重大的公共卫生问题。结果表明,具有快速且经济有效地发现中和抗体的潜力,可用于 治疗 和预防 RSV 感染。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于使用单一 RSV 菌株 (RSV A2) 进行体外中和测定,这可能无法推广到其他 RSV 菌株。由于样本量有限且使用单一菌株,证据强度中等。

title: Under pressure: lessons learnt from rapid implementation of the respiratory syncytial virus maternal vaccine and infant nirsevimab in Sydney, Australia.
abstract: OBJECTIVE: To share lessons learnt from the Sydney Local Health District (SLHD) rollout of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) prevention products, and present data on immunisation uptake for mothers and babies in two maternity hospitals. TYPE OF SERVICE: Rollout of the RSV maternal vaccine and the injectable, long-acting monoclonal antibody nirsevimab for newborn infants to protect them from RSV infection and hospitalisation. METHODS: Deidentified summary data from the electronic medical record on RSV immunisation status in two SLHD maternity hospitals were analysed descriptively as counts and proportions. The Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research was used as a lens to reflect on the rollout process. RESULTS: RSV vaccination coverage in women giving birth in two SLHD hospitals improved from 4% in the first month of rollout (February 2025) to a range of 70-74% from June to September 2025. As antenatal coverage improved, the number of live born babies requiring nirsevimab decreased. Among eligible newborns, 36% of families declined nirsevimab, with reason for refusal not recorded. Documentation of RSV immunisation status improved as the rollout progressed. LESSONS LEARNT: Engaging multidisciplinary leaders and clinicians is critical for a coordinated response and program rollout success. Leveraging existing education structures, staff meetings and using online prerecording can optimise clinician education. New programs take time to embed into routine clinical practice, and programs that involve delivering multiple immunisation products for distinct groups require clear messaging and systemic safeguards to prevent errors. Integrating immunisation into medical record workflows as standard practice can support program adoption and uptake.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to share lessons from the rapid implementation of RSV prevention products and present data on immunisation uptake for mothers and babies in two maternity hospitals. The research addresses the need for effective strategies to improve RSV vaccine and nirsevimab adoption in clinical settings.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study involved the rollout of the RSV maternal vaccine and the injectable monoclonal antibody nirsevimab in two maternity hospitals within the Sydney Local Health District. It examined immunisation uptake over a period from February to September 2025.
analysis.methods: Deidentified summary data from electronic medical records were analysed descriptively as counts and proportions. The Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research was used to evaluate the rollout process.
analysis.main_results: RSV vaccination coverage in women giving birth in the two hospitals increased from 4% in the first month of rollout to 70-74% from June to September 2025. The number of live born babies requiring nirsevimab decreased as antenatal coverage improved. Among eligible newborns, 36% of families declined nirsevimab, with reasons for refusal not recorded. Documentation of RSV immunisation status improved during the rollout.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the findings as demonstrating the importance of multidisciplinary engagement and clear messaging in the successful rollout of RSV prevention programs. The study highlights the challenges and strategies for integrating multiple immunisation products into routine clinical practice.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform the development of future RSV prevention programs by emphasizing the need for coordinated efforts, clinician education, and systematic safeguards to ensure accurate implementation. They also provide insights into improving immunisation uptake and documentation in maternity settings.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on deidentified summary data and the absence of recorded reasons for nirsevimab refusal. The evidence is moderate, as it reflects real-world implementation challenges but lacks deeper causal analysis or control groups.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the rollout of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) prevention products, including the maternal vaccine and the monoclonal antibody nirsevimab, in two maternity hospitals in Sydney, Australia. It reports that RSV vaccination coverage among mothers improved significantly from 4% in February 2025 to 70-74% by September 2025. The number of infants requiring nirsevimab decreased as maternal coverage increased, while 36% of eligible newborns declined the antibody without recorded reasons. The authors highlight the importance of multidisciplinary collaboration, clinician education, and integrating immunisation into medical workflows for successful program adoption. They note that while the rollout was effective, the study lacks detailed causal analysis and control groups, limiting the strength of the evidence to a moderate level.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在分享快速实施 RSV 预防产品的经验教训,并提供两家妇产医院母亲和婴儿的免疫接种数据。该研究解决了对有效策略的需求,以改善 RSV 疫苗 和 尼塞韦单抗 在临床环境中的采用。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及在悉尼本地卫生区的两家 maternity 医院推广呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)母体疫苗 疫苗 和可注射单克隆抗体 尼塞韦单抗,考察了 2025 年 2 月至 9 月期间的疫苗接种率。
elements_zh.methods: 从电子病历中提取的匿名汇总数据被描述性分析为计数和比例。采用实施研究综合框架(Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research)评估推广过程。
elements_zh.main_results: 在两家医院分娩的女性中,RSV 母体疫苗 疫苗接种 的接种率从推广首月的 4% 上升到 2025 年 6 月至 9 月期间的 70-74%。随着产前接种率的提高,需要 尼塞韦单抗 的活产婴儿数量减少。在符合条件的新生儿中,36% 的家庭拒绝接种 尼塞韦单抗,但拒绝的原因未被记录。在推广过程中,RSV 疫苗接种状态的记录有所改善。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为表明多学科协作和清晰信息传达在成功推广 RSV 预防计划中的重要性。该研究突出了在常规临床实践中整合多种疫苗产品的挑战和策略。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为未来 RSV 预防计划的制定提供参考,强调需要协调努力、医务人员教育和系统性保障措施以确保准确实施。它们还提供了改善 maternity 环境中疫苗接种率和记录的见解。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其依赖匿名汇总数据,且未记录 尼塞韦单抗 拒绝的原因。证据强度中等,因为它反映了实际实施中的挑战,但缺乏更深入的因果分析或对照组。

title_zh: 压力之下:从澳大利亚悉尼快速实施 呼吸道合胞病毒 孕产妇 疫苗 和婴儿 尼塞韦单抗 中吸取的经验教训。
source_body_en: OBJECTIVE: To share lessons learnt from the Sydney Local Health District (SLHD) rollout of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) prevention products, and present data on immunisation uptake for mothers and babies in two maternity hospitals. TYPE OF SERVICE: Rollout of the RSV maternal vaccine and the injectable, long-acting monoclonal antibody nirsevimab for newborn infants to protect them from RSV infection and hospitalisation. METHODS: Deidentified summary data from the electronic medical record on RSV immunisation status in two SLHD maternity hospitals were analysed descriptively as counts and proportions. The Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research was used as a lens to reflect on the rollout process. RESULTS: RSV vaccination coverage in women giving birth in two SLHD hospitals improved from 4% in the first month of rollout (February 2025) to a range of 70-74% from June to September 2025. As antenatal coverage improved, the number of live born babies requiring nirsevimab decreased. Among eligible newborns, 36% of families declined nirsevimab, with reason for refusal not recorded. Documentation of RSV immunisation status improved as the rollout progressed. LESSONS LEARNT: Engaging multidisciplinary leaders and clinicians is critical for a coordinated response and program rollout success. Leveraging existing education structures, staff meetings and using online prerecording can optimise clinician education. New programs take time to embed into routine clinical practice, and programs that involve delivering multiple immunisation products for distinct groups require clear messaging and systemic safeguards to prevent errors. Integrating immunisation into medical record workflows as standard practice can support program adoption and uptake.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在分享快速实施 RSV 预防产品的经验教训,并提供两家妇产医院母亲和婴儿的免疫接种数据。该研究解决了对有效策略的需求,以改善 RSV 疫苗 和 尼塞韦单抗 在临床环境中的采用。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究涉及在悉尼本地卫生区的两家 maternity 医院推广呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)母体疫苗 疫苗 和可注射单克隆抗体 尼塞韦单抗,考察了 2025 年 2 月至 9 月期间的疫苗接种率。
analysis_zh.methods: 从电子病历中提取的匿名汇总数据被描述性分析为计数和比例。采用实施研究综合框架(Consolidated Framework for Implementation Research)评估推广过程。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在两家医院分娩的女性中,RSV 母体疫苗 疫苗接种 的接种率从推广首月的 4% 上升到 2025 年 6 月至 9 月期间的 70-74%。随着产前接种率的提高,需要 尼塞韦单抗 的活产婴儿数量减少。在符合条件的新生儿中,36% 的家庭拒绝接种 尼塞韦单抗,但拒绝的原因未被记录。在推广过程中,RSV 疫苗接种状态的记录有所改善。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为表明多学科协作和清晰信息传达在成功推广 RSV 预防计划中的重要性。该研究突出了在常规临床实践中整合多种疫苗产品的挑战和策略。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为未来 RSV 预防计划的制定提供参考,强调需要协调努力、医务人员教育和系统性保障措施以确保准确实施。它们还提供了改善 maternity 环境中疫苗接种率和记录的见解。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 本研究的局限性在于其依赖匿名汇总数据,且未记录 尼塞韦单抗 拒绝的原因。证据强度中等,因为它反映了实际实施中的挑战,但缺乏更深入的因果分析或对照组。

title: Dissolving microneedle patches for needle-free and thermostable respiratory syncytial virus vaccination.
abstract: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) remains a major cause of acute lower respiratory tract disease, yet current prefusion F (preF)-based RSV vaccines depend on intramuscular injection and cold-chain distribution, limiting broad deployment. Dissolving microneedle array patches (MAPs) offer a minimally invasive, needle-free, and potentially thermostable alternative to conventional vaccine delivery. Here, we developed dissolving microneedle array patches loaded with an engineered prefusion-stabilized RSV F antigen (CL073A) and evaluated their potential as a needle-free, thermostable, and potent RSV vaccination platform. Following formulation screening, two lead CL073A-loaded MAPs (MAPs-CL073A) were identified that preserved antigenicity and mechanical performance and showed prolonged local antigen retention relative to intramuscular injection. In mice, MAPs-CL073A elicited markedly enhanced and durable humoral immunity, inducing approximately five-fold higher neutralizing antibody titers than intramuscular immunization at a ten-fold lower antigen dose, demonstrating a pronounced dose-sparing effect. In cotton rats, MAPs-CL073A conferred robust protection against RSV challenge by reducing lung viral burden and pulmonary pathology, with the 10 μg regimen (F2-MAP) achieving near-complete protection. Furthermore, the patches fully retained antigen bioactivity and in vivo immunogenicity after 6 months of room-temperature storage. Our findings establish that antigen delivery is a critical dimension of RSV vaccine performance and support dissolving microneedle delivery as a versatile strategy to enhance both the efficacy and deployability of RSV vaccines.

title: Predicting prolonged hospital stay in children hospitalised with respiratory syncytial virus infection: model development, internal validation and a calendar-year transportability assessment
abstract: Abstract Background. Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is the commonest cause of lower respiratory tract infection in young children, and length of stay dominates cost. Published RSV models mostly predict intensive-care outcomes from variables unavailable on a ward. We developed a model for prolonged stay from routine admission data and examined its transport across years. Retrospective cohort of children under 5 years admitted to general paediatric wards in Chengdu, China, with RSV confirmed by multiplex polymerase chain reaction, 2023–2025. Prolonged stay was 7 days or more. Fifteen admission variables were ranked by least absolute shrinkage and selection operator regression with 300 bootstrap resamples; retention required 95% selection frequency and stability across four specifications. Discrimination was assessed with 500-resample optimism correction, calibration by slope, intercept and Brier score against a constant-risk benchmark, and utility by decision curves. The primary model was refitted in 2023–2024 and applied unchanged to 2025. Of 494 admissions, 476 were analysed (median age 20.0 months; 57.6% boys); 106 (22.3%) stayed ≥ 7 days. Age (odds ratio 0.49 per 16.7 months, 95% CI 0.38–0.64), co-detection (1.73, 1.07–2.79) and lactate dehydrogenase (0.66 per 66.6 U/L, 0.51–0.86) were retained; AUC 0.708 (0.653–0.760), optimism-corrected 0.687, slope 1.00, Brier 0.158. Prolonged stay fell from 32.1% (62/193) to 15.5% (44/283) (p < 0.001). On transport discrimination was preserved (AUC 0.701, 0.623–0.772; slope 1.07) but risk was overestimated (intercept −0.82; predicted 28.3% vs observed 15.5%), and the Brier score (0.142) exceeded the constant-risk benchmark (0.131) until recalibrated (0.124). At a 20% threshold, 33.9% of 2025 admissions were low risk (negative predictive value 95.8%; 14 events missed per 1000). Three routine admission variables predicted prolonged RSV stay with moderate discrimination, preserved across calendar years, whereas absolute risk was not and needs recalibration before use. The model suits ruling out a long stay, not escalation.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to develop a model for predicting prolonged hospital stays in children with respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infection using routine admission data and assess its transportability across calendar years. A retrospective cohort of 476 children under 5 years admitted to general paediatric wards in Chengdu, China, between 2023 and 2025 was used, with RSV confirmed by multiplex polymerase chain reaction. The model incorporated 15 admission variables, selected using least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) regression with bootstrap resampling. title: Incidence, shedding, and transmission of common respiratory viruses: data from a prospective, longitudinal, household cohort study in the Gambia from March 2021-June 2022.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Respiratory viruses are a major cause of morbidity in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), yet little is known about their incidence, risk factors, and transmission dynamics in community settings. We aimed to compare the epidemiology of multiple respiratory viruses within households in the Gambia. METHODS: We conducted a prospective household cohort study in a peri-urban region of the Gambia. Households with ≥5 members, including at least one adult and one child, were enrolled and followed for one year. Upper respiratory tract swabs were collected weekly, regardless of symptoms, and tested by RT-PCR for SARS-CoV-2, seasonal coronaviruses, human rhinovirus (HRV), influenza A/B, RSV A/B, parainfluenza viruses 1-4, human metapneumovirus, and adenovirus. We estimated incidence, symptomatic fraction, shedding duration, and household secondary attack rates (SARs), and explored associations with virus type and demographic variables. FINDINGS: From 2 March 2021 to 13 June 2022, 349 participants from 52 households completed 14,421 scheduled and 129 unscheduled visits. Respiratory viruses were detected in 11.1% of visits (n = 1611), representing 1423 infection episodes. HRV was most common, infecting 86.5% of participants (2.4 infections per person-year). Children aged <5 and 5-17 years shed virus for longer than adults (p = 0.0005), with longer shedding durations seen for HRV and SARS-CoV-2. Overall, 88.4% of infections were asymptomatic, with the highest symptomatic proportions for SARS-CoV-2 (16.3%) and RSV (17.7%) (p = 0.03). We found evidence for reductions in incidence risk with increasing age for HRV, RSV, seasonal coronaviruses, and parainfluenza viruses, with no difference for SARS-CoV-2. Among 719 index infections, the mean household SARs for all viruses combined was 6.7%. Infection with prolonged shedding (p = 0.002), specific viral species (p < 0.0001) and a lower Ct value were associated with increased transmission. INTERPRETATION: A large burden of asymptomatic infections underlies the circulation of respiratory viruses within households, with key differences in incidence, shedding and transmission across viral species. FUNDING: This study was funded through a UK Research and Innovation grant.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to compare the epidemiology of multiple respiratory viruses within households in the Gambia. A prospective household cohort study was conducted in a peri-urban region, enrolling households with ≥5 members, including at least one adult and one child, and following them for one year. Weekly upper respiratory tract swabs were collected and tested by RT-PCR for various viruses, including respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). The study found that respiratory viruses were detected in 11.1% of visits, with HRV being the most common. Children aged <5 and 5-17 years shed virus for longer than adults, and asymptomatic infections were prevalent, with the highest symptomatic proportions for SARS-CoV-2 and RSV. The mean household secondary attack rates for all viruses combined was 6.7%. The study highlights the significant role of asymptomatic infections in household transmission dynamics and the differences in incidence, shedding, and transmission across viral species. However, the study's findings are limited by its single-location setting and lack of experimental controls, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

Children aged <5 and 5-17 years shed virus for longer than adults (p = 0.0005), with longer shedding durations seen for HRV and SARS-CoV-2. Overall, 88.4% of infections were asymptomatic, with the highest symptomatic proportions for SARS-CoV-2 (16.3%) and RSV (17.7%) (p = 0.03).
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 无症状感染的巨大负担是呼吸道病毒在家庭内传播的基础,不同病毒种类在 发病率、脱落和 发病率 方面存在重大差异。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为传播和呼吸道病毒的风险评估策略提供信息,特别强调无症状感染者在家庭传播动态中的作用。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是在冈比亚的一个城郊地区进行的,限制了普遍性。证据是温和的,因为它基于观察数据并且不包括实验对照。

title: Subtype-specific differences in susceptibility to monoclonal antibodies and vaccines among contemporary RSV-A and RSV-B isolates
abstract: ABSTRACT Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) continues to circulate at high levels despite the introduction of new monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) and vaccines targeting the pre-fusion F (pre-F) protein. We analyzed the viral genome sequences of 133 RSV clinical samples collected during the 2022–2023 and 2023–2024 seasons and selected representative isolates for phenotypic testing. We selected four RSV-A and four RSV-B replication-competent, sequence-verified stocks and then assessed them for replication kinetics in vitro and neutralization sensitivity with a panel of F-targeting mAbs and polyclonal sera using a rabbit vaccination model. Isolates retained sensitivity to all mAbs tested. We detected no mutations in mAb binding sites in the isolates tested. RSV-A isolates were slightly less susceptible to multiple mAbs than RSV-B isolates. Antigenic cartography revealed a separation of antibody responses by subtype: RSV-A isolates clustered together and aligned with lower neutralization by antibodies such as MPE8 and 101F, whereas RSV-B isolates formed a distinct cluster associated with higher mAb susceptibility. In a rabbit vaccination model, RSV-A-only sera efficiently neutralized all RSV-A isolates and the RSV-B1 reference strain but showed diminished activity against contemporary RSV-B isolates. RSV-B-only sera displayed balanced neutralization across both subtypes. Combined RSV-A + RSV-B immunization produced uniformly strong responses to all isolates, suggesting that multivalent exposure may overcome subtype-specific antibody polarization. Collectively, our results demonstrate consistent antigenic divergence of RSV subtypes and underscore the importance of using contemporary isolates, rather than legacy reference strains, to guide F-directed immunoprophylaxis and vaccine design. IMPORTANCE Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) remains a major cause of lower respiratory tract infections. Although new monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) and vaccines have been approved in recent years, the impact of circulating genetic diversity on these therapeutics is incompletely understood. In this study, we demonstrate how recent RSV isolates respond to a panel of mAbs and whether sera from rabbits vaccinated with mRNA vaccines effectively neutralize these isolates. We observe that RSV-A isolates are slightly more resistant to neutralization by mAbs than RSV-B isolates and that a bivalent vaccine elicits broader neutralizing responses than the monovalent vaccine. This study provides insights into how viral diversity may influence antibody-mediated protection and suggests that recent RSV-B isolates may respond differently from the laboratory-adapted strains commonly used in research, an important consideration for the design of next-generation vaccines and antibody therapeutics.

title_zh: 当代RSV-A和RSV-B分离株对单克隆抗体和疫苗的亚型特异性易感性差异
source_body_en: ABSTRACT Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) continues to circulate at high levels despite the introduction of new monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) and vaccines targeting the pre-fusion F (pre-F) protein. We analyzed the viral genome sequences of 133 RSV clinical samples collected during the 2022–2023 and 2023–2024 seasons and selected representative isolates for phenotypic testing. We selected four RSV-A and four RSV-B replication-competent, sequence-verified stocks and then assessed them for replication kinetics in vitro and neutralization sensitivity with a panel of F-targeting mAbs and polyclonal sera using a rabbit vaccination model. Isolates retained sensitivity to all mAbs tested. We detected no mutations in mAb binding sites in the isolates tested. RSV-A isolates were slightly less susceptible to multiple mAbs than RSV-B isolates. Antigenic cartography revealed a separation of antibody responses by subtype: RSV-A isolates clustered together and aligned with lower neutralization by antibodies such as MPE8 and 101F, whereas RSV-B isolates formed a distinct cluster associated with higher mAb susceptibility. In a rabbit vaccination model, RSV-A-only sera efficiently neutralized all RSV-A isolates and the RSV-B1 reference strain but showed diminished activity against contemporary RSV-B isolates. RSV-B-only sera displayed balanced neutralization across both subtypes. Combined RSV-A + RSV-B immunization produced uniformly strong responses to all isolates, suggesting that multivalent exposure may overcome subtype-specific antibody polarization. Collectively, our results demonstrate consistent antigenic divergence of RSV subtypes and underscore the importance of using contemporary isolates, rather than legacy reference strains, to guide F-directed immunoprophylaxis and vaccine design. IMPORTANCE Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) remains a major cause of lower respiratory tract infections. Although new monoclonal antibodies (mAbs) and vaccines have been approved in recent years, the impact of circulating genetic diversity on these therapeutics is incompletely understood. In this study, we demonstrate how recent RSV isolates respond to a panel of mAbs and whether sera from rabbits vaccinated with mRNA vaccines effectively neutralize these isolates. We observe that RSV-A isolates are slightly more resistant to neutralization by mAbs than RSV-B isolates and that a bivalent vaccine elicits broader neutralizing responses than the monovalent vaccine. This study provides insights into how viral diversity may influence antibody-mediated protection and suggests that recent RSV-B isolates may respond differently from the laboratory-adapted strains commonly used in research, an important consideration for the design of next-generation vaccines and antibody therapeutics.
abstract_zh: 摘要 呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)尽管引入了新的单克隆抗体(mAbs)和疫苗,仍持续在高水平流行。我们分析了2022–2023和2023–2024季节收集的133份RSV临床样本的病毒基因组序列,并选择了代表性的分离株进行表型测试。我们选择了四种RSV-A和四种RSV-B具有复制能力且序列验证的株系,然后使用兔疫苗接种模型评估了它们的体外复制动力学和对F靶向单克隆抗体和多克隆血清的中和敏感性。所有测试的分离株均保留了对所有mAbs的敏感性。我们在测试的分离株中未检测到mAb结合位点的突变。RSV-A分离株对多种mAbs的中和敏感性略低于RSV-B分离株。抗原图谱显示了抗体反应的亚型分离:RSV-A分离株聚类在一起,并与如MPE8和101F等抗体的中和能力较低相一致,而RSV-B分离株则形成一个与较高mAb敏感性相关的独特聚类。在兔疫苗接种模型中,RSV-A-only血清能够有效中和所有RSV-A分离株和RSV-B1参考株,但对当代RSV-B分离株的中和活性有所减弱。RSV-B-only血清在两种亚型之间表现出平衡的中和能力。RSV-A + RSV-B联合免疫产生了对所有分离株一致的强反应,这表明多价暴露可能克服亚型特异性抗体极化。总体而言,我们的结果展示了RSV亚型之间一致的抗原差异,并强调了使用当代分离株而非传统参考株来指导F靶向免疫预防和疫苗设计的重要性。重要性 呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)仍然是下呼吸道感染的主要原因。尽管近年来批准了新的单克隆抗体(mAbs)和疫苗,但这些治疗药物对流行遗传多样性的影响仍不完全清楚。本研究探讨了近期RSV分离株对一组mAbs的反应情况,以及使用mRNA 疫苗免疫的兔血清是否能有效中和这些分离株。我们观察到RSV-A分离株对mAbs的中和能力略低于RSV-B分离株,并且双价疫苗比单价疫苗诱导更广泛的中和反应。本研究提供了关于病毒多样性如何影响抗体介导保护的见解,并表明近期RSV-B分离株可能与常用于研究的实验室适应株产生不同的反应,这对下一代疫苗和抗体治疗药物的设计具有重要意义。

title: Forecasting Respiratory Syncytial Virus Activity Using Seasonal ARIMA Models: Evidence from CDC Weekly Surveillance Data
abstract: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) imposes seasonal operational pressure on paediatric care and hospital healthcare systems. This study evaluates whether weekly RSV test percent positivity data from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) National Respiratory and Enteric Virus Surveillance System (NREVSS) can support short-term forecasting of RSV transmission activity. The national weekly surveillance dataset spanning 3 January 2015 to 27 June 2020 was analyzed with four forecasting approaches: seasonal autoreggressive integrated moving average (SARIMA), non-seasonal autoregressive integrated moving average (ARIMA), exponential smoothing (ETS), and a seasonal naive benchmark model. Model predictive performance was validated via a 52-week chronological holdout sample and rolling-origin forecasts for 1–4 week ahead horizons. Multiple evaluation metrics were adopted, including root mean square error (RMSE), mean absolute error (MAE), symmetric mean absolute percentage error (sMAPE), directional accuracy, and peak-timing error. Exploratory time-series analyses verified prominent annual seasonality and short-term serial dependence embedded in RSV percent positivity time series. Among all candidate models, SARIMA yielded the smallest RMSE and MAE on the holdout dataset, and exhibited relatively robust performance as the forecast window extended. The overall findings demonstrate that surveillance-driven SARIMA forecasting can facilitate early epidemic warning and advance healthcare resource planning. Nevertheless, further external validation using post-pandemic and regional RSV surveillance datasets is required, as the sample only covers the pre-pandemic and early coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19 ) period.
journal: International Journal of Biology and Life Sciences

source_records.title: Forecasting Respiratory Syncytial Virus Activity Using Seasonal ARIMA Models: Evidence from CDC Weekly Surveillance Data
source_records.abstract: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) imposes seasonal operational pressure on paediatric care and hospital healthcare systems. This study evaluates whether weekly RSV test percent positivity data from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) National Respiratory and Enteric Virus Surveillance System (NREVSS) can support short-term forecasting of RSV transmission activity. The national weekly surveillance dataset spanning 3 January 2015 to 27 June 2020 was analyzed with four forecasting approaches: seasonal autoreggressive integrated moving average (SARIMA), non-seasonal autoregressive integrated moving average (ARIMA), exponential smoothing (ETS), and a seasonal naive benchmark model. Model predictive performance was validated via a 52-week chronological holdout sample and rolling-origin forecasts for 1–4 week ahead horizons. Multiple evaluation metrics were adopted, including root mean square error (RMSE), mean absolute error (MAE), symmetric mean absolute percentage error (sMAPE), directional accuracy, and peak-timing error. Exploratory time-series analyses verified prominent annual seasonality and short-term serial dependence embedded in RSV percent positivity time series. Among all candidate models, SARIMA yielded the smallest RMSE and MAE on the holdout dataset, and exhibited relatively robust performance as the forecast window extended. The overall findings demonstrate that surveillance-driven SARIMA forecasting can facilitate early epidemic warning and advance healthcare resource planning. Nevertheless, further external validation using post-pandemic and regional RSV surveillance datasets is required, as the sample only covers the pre-pandemic and early coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19 ) period.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用四种预测方法对2015年1月3日至2020年6月27日的全国每周监测数据集进行了分析:季节性自回归综合移动平均线(SARIMA)、非季节性自回归综合移动平均线(ARIMA)、指数平滑(ETS)和季节性朴素基准模型。

elements_zh.main_results: 探索性时间序列分析验证了 RSV 阳性率时间序列中嵌入的显着的年度季节性和短期序列依赖性。在所有候选模型中,SARIMA 在保留数据集上产生了最小的 RMSE 和 MAE,并且随着预测窗口的扩展表现出相对稳健的性能。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 总体研究结果表明,监测 驱动的 SARIMA 预测可以促进早期流行病预警并推进医疗资源规划。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该研究提供的证据表明 SARIMA 模型可用于预测 RSV 活动,从而为季节性 暴发 的医疗资源规划和早期预警系统提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 尽管如此,仍需要使用大流行后和区域 RSV 监测 数据集进行进一步的外部验证,因为样本仅涵盖大流行前和早期的 2019 年冠状病毒病 (COVID-19) 时期。

title: Respiratory syncytial virus in adults in Moscow (2024–2025) - a case series
abstract: The role of respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) in the development of severe infections and decompensation of chronic diseases in adults is often underestimated. In the Russian Federation, data on the clinical course of RSV infection in adults are extremely limited. The article presents three clinical cases of RSV infection in adult patients identified during a prospective study of RSV prevalence among 1,544 patients with acute respiratory infection in Moscow (epidemic season 2024–2025). The first case is a severe exacerbation of asthma in a 73-year-old woman with obesity and hypertension, requiring hospitalization. The second case is RSV-associated pneumonia in a 39-year-old man without comorbidities, complicated by myocardial infarction on the second day of hospitalization; co-infection with coronavirus HKU-1. The third case is a prolonged course of RSV infection (acute tracheitis progressing to bronchitis) in a 75-year-old woman with multiple comorbidities, leading to decompensation of arterial hypertension. The presented cases illustrate various patterns of RSV infection in adults, highlighting the role of RSV as a trigger for exacerbation of chronic diseases and vascular events, as well as the challenges of differential diagnosis and management of such patients in real-world clinical practice. RSV infection in adults often remains overlooked by clinicians, despite its ability to cause severe outcomes even in patients without underlying risk factors. The heterogeneity of manifestations and the absence of pathognomonic symptoms necessitate the improvement of epidemiological surveillance and an in-depth study of the RSV burden to substantiate prevention strategies in vulnerable adult populations. Keywords: respiratory syncytial virus, adults, case series, comorbidity, myocardial infarction.

The article presents three clinical cases of RSV infection in adult patients identified during a prospective study of RSV prevalence among 1,544 patients with acute respiratory infection in Moscow (epidemic season 2024–2025). The first case is a severe exacerbation of asthma in a 73-year-old woman with obesity and hypertension, requiring hospitalization. The second case is RSV-associated pneumonia in a 39-year-old man without comorbidities, complicated by myocardial infarction on the second day of hospitalization; co-infection with coronavirus HKU-1. The third case is a prolonged course of RSV infection (acute tracheitis progressing to bronchitis) in a 75-year-old woman with multiple comorbidities, leading to decompensation of arterial hypertension. The presented cases illustrate various patterns of RSV infection in adults, highlighting the role of RSV as a trigger for exacerbation of chronic diseases and vascular events, as well as the challenges of differential diagnosis and management of such patients in real-world clinical practice. RSV infection in adults often remains overlooked by clinicians, despite its ability to cause severe outcomes even in patients without underlying risk factors. The heterogeneity of manifestations and the absence of pathognomonic symptoms necessitate the improvement of epidemiological surveillance and an in-depth study of the RSV burden to substantiate prevention strategies in vulnerable adult populations. Keywords: respiratory syncytial virus, adults, case series, comorbidity, myocardial infarction.

title: Sendai virus, a candidate vaccine for the prevention of respiratory virus infections in children: a review
abstract: Background Respiratory viruses including human parainfluenza virus (hPIV), respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), and human metapneumovirus (hMPV), pose serious, potentially lethal threats to humans, particularly infants and young children. While maternal vaccines and monoclonal antibodies are advancing to provide transient protection against these viruses, licensed pediatric vaccines are not yet available. Sendai virus (SeV) is now being developed as an intranasal (I.N.) vaccine candidate for the prevention of serious respiratory viral infections in children. Methods To examine the potential of replication-competent Sendai virus and its recombinants as pediatric respiratory virus vaccines against hPIV, RSV and hMPV, we searched literature databases and evaluated both historical and contemporary published research. Results SeV and SeV recombinant vaccines have been tested pre-clinically in a variety of animal models and in Phase I clinical studies. In pre-clinical models, a single dose of SeV induced rapid and long-lasting B- and T-cell responses in the upper respiratory tract and blood. When recombinant SeV constructs were produced and formulated into cocktail vaccines, they were protective against four different respiratory pathogens simultaneously. Vaccines were successful when partnered with passively transferred antibodies; specifically, when a recombinant SeV-based RSV vaccine was tested in the presence of passively transferred monoclonal or polyclonal PIV-specific or RSV-specific antibodies in a cotton rat model, the vaccine provided durable protective immunity against RSV. In clinical trials, SeV was well-tolerated and uniformly immunogenic in PIV-seropositive 1–2 year old children. Methods have been developed for the manufacture of stable SeV-based vaccine products, compatible with wide global distribution of SeV vaccines for clinical use. Conclusion To date, results highlight SeV as an attractive pediatric vaccine candidate. Continued clinical testing of SeV may provide global relief from serious respiratory viral infections in infants and young children.

abstract_zh: 背景 呼吸道病毒,包括人副流感病毒(hPIV)、呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)和人偏肺病毒(hMPV),对人类,特别是婴儿和幼儿构成严重的、潜在致命的威胁。虽然母体 疫苗 和单克隆抗体正在进步以提供针对这些病毒的短暂保护,但尚未获得获得许可的儿科 疫苗。仙台病毒 (SeV) 目前正在开发为鼻内 (I.N.) 疫苗 候选药物,用于预防儿童严重呼吸道病毒感染。方法 为了检验具有复制能力的仙台病毒及其重组体作为儿科呼吸道病毒 疫苗 对抗 hPIV、RSV 和 hMPV 的潜力,我们检索了文献数据库并评估了历史和当代已发表的研究。结果 SeV 和 SeV 重组 疫苗 已在多种动物模型和 I 期临床研究中进行了临床前测试。在临床前模型中,单剂量的 SeV 可在上呼吸道和血液中诱导快速且持久的 B 细胞和 T 细胞反应。当重组 SeV 构建体被生产出来并配制成鸡尾酒 疫苗 时,它们可以同时抵抗四种不同的呼吸道病原体。疫苗 与被动转移抗体配合使用取得了成功;具体来说,当在棉鼠模型中在被动转移的单克隆或多克隆PIV特异性或RSV特异性抗体存在的情况下测试基于SeV的重组RSV 疫苗时,疫苗提供了针对RSV的持久保护性免疫力。在临床试验中,SeV 在 PIV 血清阳性 1-2 岁儿童中具有良好的耐受性和一致的免疫原性。已经开发出用于制造基于 SeV 的稳定 疫苗 产品的方法,该产品与临床使用的 SeV 疫苗 的全球广泛分布兼容。结论 迄今为止,结果表明 SeV 是一种有吸引力的儿科 疫苗 候选药物。SeV 的持续临床测试可能会在全球范围内缓解婴儿和幼儿严重呼吸道病毒感染的问题。

title: Temporal dynamics of respiratory pathogens among adult SARI patients in Shanghai, 2019–2023: a multi-center longitudinal surveillance study
abstract: COVID-19 greatly reshaped the epidemiology of severe acute respiratory infection (SARI), yet long-term shifts in multi-pathogen circulation remain poorly characterized.This study explored temporal patterns of common respiratory pathogens among adult SARI patients before, during, and after the pandemic. A retrospective multi-center observational study was performed across seven sentinel hospitals in Shanghai, China (2019–2023). Hospitalized SARI patients aged ≥ 15 years were tested for 12 respiratory pathogens (22 subtypes) using real-time polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR). We stratified the study period into pre-pandemic (2019), pandemic (2020–2022), and post-pandemic (2023) phases for comparative analysis. In total, 4738 participants were enrolled. The overall pathogen detection rate decreased from 30.26% in the pre-pandemic period (2019) to 16.50% during the pandemic (2020–2022), then rebounded to 20.07% in the post-pandemic period (2023) ( P <0.001). A novel classification of four distinct temporal trends was established: (1) decline-resurgence for influenza virus (IFV), Mycoplasma pneumoniae ( M. pneumoniae ), Bordetella pertussis ( B. pertussis ), and human bocavirus (HBoV); (2) sustained decline for human parainfluenza virus (HPIV), human coronavirus (HCoV), human adenovirus (HAdV), human rhinovirus/enterovirus (HRV/EV), and Legionella pneumophila ( L. pneumophila ); (3) transient peak for human metapneumovirus (HMPV); (4) continuous increase for respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). IFV, HRV/EV, and HCoV consistently ranked top five across all periods. pneumoniae was the dominant pathogen (33.65%) in patients aged 15–44 years. Seasonal peaks of IFV and RSV were substantially reshaped in the post-pandemic period. The co-infection rate was 1.14% (54/4738), with IFV- M. pneumoniae was the most combination (20.37%). Respiratory pathogen circulation patterns changed substantially from 2019 to 2023. Persistent multi-pathogen surveillance is required to guard against single-pathogen outbreaks and concurrent multi-pathogen epidemics.

abstract_zh: COVID-19 极大地重塑了严重急性呼吸道感染 (SARI) 的 流行病学,但多病原体循环的长期变化仍知之甚少。本研究探讨了成人 SARI 患者在大流行之前、期间和之后常见呼吸道病原体的时间模式。对中国上海七家哨点医院(2019-2023)进行了回顾性多中心观察研究。使用实时聚合酶链反应 (RT-PCR) 对年龄≥ 15 岁的住院 SARI 患者进行了 12 种呼吸道病原体(22 种亚型)检测。我们将研究时期分为大流行前(2019年)、大流行(2020-2022年)和大流行后(2023年)三个阶段进行比较分析。总共有 4738 名参与者参加。总体病原检出率从疫情前期(2019年)的30.26%下降至疫情期间(2020-2022年)的16.50%,随后反弹至疫情后期(2023年)的20.07%( P <0.001)。建立了四种不同时间趋势的新分类:(1)流感病毒(IFV)、肺炎支原体(M.pneumoniae)、百日咳博德特氏菌(B.pertussis)和人博卡病毒(HBoV)的下降-复苏;(2)人副流感病毒(HPIV)、人冠状病毒(HCoV)、人腺病毒(HAdV)、人鼻病毒/肠道病毒(HRV/EV)、嗜肺军团菌(L. pneumophila)持续下降;(3)人偏肺病毒(HMPV)瞬时峰;(4)持续增加呼吸道合胞病毒(RSV)。IFV、HRV/EV 和 HCoV 在所有时期均排名前五。肺炎链球菌是15-44岁患者的主要病原体(33.65%)。IFV 和 RSV 的季节性峰值在大流行后时期大幅重塑。合并感染率为1.14%(54/4738),其中以IFV-肺炎支原体合并感染最多(20.37%)。从 2019 年到 2023 年,呼吸道病原体循环模式发生了很大变化。需要持续的多病原体 监测 来防范单一病原体 暴发 和并发的多病原体流行。

title: AS01E-adjuvanted RSV pre-F protein vaccine in adults with lung or kidney transplant: a phase 2b randomized trial.
abstract: Immunocompromised adults are at increased risk of severe respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) disease. This multicountry, open-label phase 2b trial (NCT05921903) evaluated the immunogenicity and safety of the AS01E-adjuvanted RSV prefusion F protein vaccine (adjuvanted RSVPreF3) over 12 months in kidney or lung transplant recipients ≥18 years, randomized 1:1 to receive one (n = 131) or two doses 30–60 days apart (n = 130). A control group of non-immunocompromised adults ≥50 years (n = 125) received a single dose. The primary outcome was the mean geometric increase in RSV-A and RSV-B neutralizing titers one month following a second adjuvanted RSVPreF3 dose relative to the first dose in transplant recipients. Secondary outcomes included assessment of the safety and immunogenicity of adjuvanted RSVPreF3 in transplant recipients compared with the control group. In transplant recipients receiving two doses, neutralizing titers against RSV-A and RSV-B were numerically higher one month post-dose 2 than post-dose 1 (mean geometric increases: 1.34 [95% CI: 1.20, 1.48] for RSV-A [n = 111] and 1.26 [95% CI: 1.14, 1.40] for RSV-B [n = 111]). A single dose was immunogenic in transplant recipients, but showed slower and generally lower initial neutralizing responses than in non-immunocompromised controls, specifically in individuals receiving mycophenolate. RSVPreF3-specific CD4 + T-cell frequencies increased after vaccination versus baseline in all groups. Humoral and cell-mediated immune responses remained above baseline for 12 months post-vaccination. Both doses of adjuvanted RSVPreF3 were well tolerated and had a similar and acceptable safety profile. Overall, these results support a favorable benefit-risk profile of adjuvanted RSVPreF3 in kidney and lung transplant recipients. title: Vaccine profile of adjuvanted RSVPreF3 in adults: prevention of RSV-related lower respiratory tract disease and emerging evidence of potential cardiovascular and respiratory benefits.
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) is an important cause of lower respiratory tract disease (LRTD) and hospitalization in older adults, individuals with certain chronic medical conditions, and immunocompromised patients. RSV can result in acute and longer-term cardiovascular and respiratory morbidity, and declines in physical functioning and quality of life. AREAS COVERED: Adjuvanted RSVPreF3 was the first RSV vaccine licensed for preventing RSV-LRTD in adults, with initial approvals in 2023 in the United States and Europe. Robust clinical trial data showed an acceptable safety profile and demonstrated efficacy against RSV-LRTD, with exploratory post-hoc analyses suggesting reductions in RSV-related chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)/asthma exacerbations. These findings are reinforced by real-world evidence showing effectiveness against RSV-related hospitalizations, COPD/asthma exacerbations, and cardiovascular events. EXPERT OPINION: This emerging evidence supports a broader role of adjuvanted RSVPreF3 beyond preventing RSV-LRTD alone to preserve cardiovascular and respiratory health. RSV vaccination should be considered within an integrated routine care and preventive management strategy for older adults and individuals with chronic conditions, alongside other adult immunizations and health interventions. Addressing implementation barriers for adjuvanted RSVPreF3 and emphasizing its role in maintaining health and independence will be critical to enable widespread uptake and help protect patient health.

AREAS COVERED: Adjuvanted RSVPreF3 was the first RSV vaccine licensed for preventing RSV-LRTD in adults, with initial approvals in 2023 in the United States and Europe. Robust clinical trial data showed an acceptable safety profile and demonstrated efficacy against RSV-LRTD, with exploratory post-hoc analyses suggesting reductions in RSV-related chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD)/asthma exacerbations. These findings are reinforced by real-world evidence showing effectiveness against RSV-related hospitalizations, COPD/asthma exacerbations, and cardiovascular events. EXPERT OPINION: This emerging evidence supports a broader role of adjuvanted RSVPreF3 beyond preventing RSV-LRTD alone to preserve cardiovascular and respiratory health. RSV vaccination should be considered within an integrated routine care and preventive management strategy for older adults and individuals with chronic conditions, alongside other adult immunizations and health interventions. Addressing implementation barriers for adjuvanted RSVPreF3 and emphasizing its role in maintaining health and independence will be critical to enable widespread uptake and help protect patient health.

elements_zh.scope_and_question: 呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 是老年人、患有某些慢性疾病的人和免疫功能低下患者下呼吸道疾病 (LRTD) 和住院的重要原因。该综述重点关注成人中佐剂 RSVPreF3 的 疫苗 概况,特别是其对 RSV 相关下呼吸道疾病的预防以及潜在心血管和呼吸系统益处的新证据。
elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该审查基于临床试验数据和真实世界证据。可靠的临床试验数据显示了可接受的安全性,并证明了对 RSV-LRTD 的有效性,探索性事后分析表明 RSV 相关的慢性阻塞性肺病 (COPD)/哮喘急性加重的情况有所减少。现实世界的证据证实了这些发现,这些证据显示其对 RSV 相关住院、慢性阻塞性肺病/哮喘恶化和心血管事件的有效性。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 佐剂 RSVPreF3 是第一个获得许可用于预防成人 RSV-LRTD 的 RSV 疫苗,于 2023 年在美国和欧洲获得初步批准。疫苗 已显示出针对 RSV-LRTD 的功效,并有新的证据表明其具有潜在的心血管和呼吸系统益处,包括减少 COPD/哮喘恶化以及针对 RSV 相关住院和心血管事件的有效性。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述指出,虽然临床试验数据支持辅助 RSVPreF3 对抗 RSV-LRTD 的安全性和有效性,但探索性事后分析表明 COPD/哮喘恶化和心血管事件的减少尚不确定。这些更广泛益处的证据仍在不断涌现,需要进一步验证。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: RSV 疫苗接种 应与其他成人免疫接种和健康干预措施一起纳入针对老年人和慢性病患者的综合常规护理和预防管理策略中。解决辅助 RSVPreF3 的实施障碍并强调其在维持健康和独立性方面的作用对于实现广泛采用并帮助保护患者健康至关重要。

title: The "ever-vaccinated" stock-flow bias in adult RSV vaccine policy evaluation: A methodological caution and a flow-based remedy.
abstract: ABSTRACT Adult respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) vaccines are recommended as a single dose without routine revaccination; cumulative “ever-vaccinated” coverage is therefore a stock variable rising mechanically each season. Prior guidance implies this stock–flow distinction, yet no study has provided a portable, instrument-agnostic remedy or quantified this decomposition for the 2025–26 season. Using weekly 2025–26 U.S. National Immunization Survey data, we decomposed cumulative coverage into a prior-season stock and current-season flow, approximating the stock by the season-opening estimate. As of the latest available 2025–26 data (week ending 2026–02-21; mid-season snapshot), 84.9% of coverage among adults 75+ (43.2%) and 82.9% among high-risk adults 50–74 (32.8%) was attributable to prior-season stock – only 15–17% reflected current-season behavior; this stock share is an empirical approximation, not an exact decomposition. In two exploratory region-level quasi-experiments, the flow metric showed no sustained uptake acceleration (all primary tests p ≥ .19; a transient early-season gap, p = .008 post hoc, did not persist); these underpowered analyses are illustrative only, not identified for the policy effect. To our knowledge, this is the first portable flow-metric operationalization for survey and registry data, released as open code. Registry data exploratorily show the stock metric can obscure equity monitoring (Gini 0.210→0.202; range 39.7→43.5 pp; not significant). As a mid-season snapshot, these figures are an upper bound on the end-of-season value; the conclusion that coverage is dominated by prior-season stock holds through the season. RSV policy evaluation should pre-specify current-season flow as the primary outcome and report the stock share as a strongly recommended diagnostic.

analysis.summary_en: This review highlights the methodological challenge of evaluating adult RSV vaccine policy using the "ever-vaccinated" stock variable, which accumulates mechanically without reflecting current-season vaccination behavior. The authors decomposed coverage into stock and flow components using 2025–26 U.S. National Immunization Survey data, finding that prior-season stock accounted for 84.9% of coverage among adults 75+ and 82.9% among high-risk adults 50–74. These findings suggest that stock metrics may obscure equity monitoring in vaccine policy. The review also notes that exploratory quasi-experiments showed no sustained uptake acceleration in the flow metric, indicating the need for more robust analyses. The authors propose that future RSV policy evaluations should prioritize current-season flow as the primary outcome and report the stock share as a diagnostic tool.

title: Respiratory Infections at Mass Gatherings: A Travel-Medicine Review with Hajj and Umrah as a Longitudinal Case Study.
abstract: BACKGROUND: Mass gatherings combine international mobility with dense, repeated contact and can amplify respiratory infections across travel corridors. Hajj, Umrah and Kumbh Mela, offer a uniquely recurrent case study, while other religious or sporting mega-events, and music or cultural festivals provide contrasting exposure systems. METHODS: A focused narrative review was conducted of peer-reviewed studies, systematic and scoping reviews, and authoritative public-health guidance. Searches and project evidence synthesis prioritized publications from January 2021 to August 2026, with selected foundational sources. We examined respiratory symptoms, laboratory detections, clinical disease, vaccination, antimicrobial use and resistance, surveillance, environmental modifiers, and pre-, during-, and post-travel practice. No meta-analysis or formal risk-of-bias scoring was undertaken. RESULTS: Respiratory risk is determined less by attendance alone than by contact intensity, duration, ventilation, vocalization, shared accommodation, traveler susceptibility, and pathogen circulation. Recent Hajj evidence confirms a substantial burden of respiratory symptoms and clinical consultations, but estimates vary because denominators range from volunteers and tested samples to healthcare encounters. It highlights that respiratory risk is influenced by factors such as contact intensity, duration, ventilation, and traveler susceptibility, rather than attendance alone. The evidence base includes a narrative review of peer-reviewed studies, systematic and scoping reviews, and public-health guidance, with a focus on publications from 2021 to 2026. It concludes that surveillance methods should be complementary, not interchangeable, and that layered interventions like vaccination and antimicrobial stewardship can reduce respiratory morbidity. The review emphasizes the need for maintaining denominator discipline and access to protective infrastructure.

abstract_zh: 背景:大型集会将国际流动性与密集、反复接触结合在一起,可能会加剧旅行走廊中的呼吸道感染。朝觐、副朝和大壶节提供了独特的循环案例研究,而其他宗教或体育大型活动以及音乐或文化节则提供了对比鲜明的曝光系统。方法:对同行评审的研究、系统性和范围界定的评审以及权威的公共卫生指导进行重点叙述性评审。搜索和项目证据综合优先考虑 2021 年 1 月至 2026 年 8 月的出版物,并选择基础来源。我们检查了呼吸道症状、实验室检测、临床疾病、疫苗接种、抗菌药物的使用和耐药性、监测、环境调节剂以及旅行前、旅行期间和旅行后的实践。没有进行荟萃分析或正式的偏倚风险评分。结果:呼吸风险不仅仅取决于出勤率,还取决于接触强度、持续时间、通风、发声、共用住宿、旅行者易感性和病原体循环。最近的朝觐证据证实了呼吸道症状和临床咨询的巨大负担,但估计有所不同,因为分母范围从志愿者和测试样本到医疗保健遭遇。鼻病毒、流感、SARS-CoV-2、呼吸道合胞病毒 (RSV) 和细菌性肺炎仍然很重要。主要针对病毒性综合症的抗生素持续滥用,耐药微生物的获得将个人护理与全球抗菌素耐药性联系起来。综合征、实验室、基于事件、基因组和废水 监测 是互补的,不可互换。高温、灰尘、空气质量、疲劳和防护基础设施的差异会改变呼吸道症状、严重程度和寻求护理的情况。比较事件共享机制,但不直接转移速率。结论:旅行医学实践应将群众集会视为涵盖准备、运输、活动和返回的纵向暴露系统。分层的 疫苗接种、基于风险的掩蔽、通风和人群流动措施、及时诊断、抗菌药物管理和明确的旅行史,可以减少呼吸道疾病发病率,同时保持分母纪律和保护性基础设施的使用。

title: Surveillance of adverse events following immunisation in Australia, 2024.
abstract: This report summarises Australia's spontaneous surveillance data for adverse events following immunisation (AEFI) for all vaccines administered in 2024, reported to the Therapeutic Goods Administration (TGA). An adverse event(s) following immunisation is defined as any untoward medical occurrence which follows immunisation but does not necessarily have a causal relationship with use of the vaccine. Analyses of AEFI data are done continuously and also annually to detect new potential safety issues or changes to known safety issues. Overall, there were 6,232 AEFI reports for vaccines administered in 2024. This represents an annual AEFI reporting rate of 22.9 per 100,000 population and 25.7 per 100,000 vaccine doses, compared with 20.8 per 100,000 population and 24.1 per 100,000 doses in 2023. The slight increase in the AEFI reporting rates observed in 2024 was likely driven by the introduction of a new recombinant zoster vaccine (RZV, Shingrix) which replaced the live attenuated zoster vaccine (ZLV, Zostavax) on the National Immunisation Program (NIP) from November 2023, along with the expansion of the eligible population for zoster vaccination. In 2024, RZV (Shingrix) was associated with the highest number of reported AEFIs. The most frequently reported adverse events following immunisation were medication errors; hypersensitivity; gastrointestinal nonspecific symptoms; pyrexia; and injection site reaction. Among vaccines newly introduced in 2024, the most commonly reported adverse events were medication errors and nonspecific gastrointestinal symptoms for COVID-19 vaccines (Comirnaty XBB.1.5 and Spikevax XBB.1.5); hypersensitivity and pyrexia for the DTPa-HepB-IPV-Hib vaccine (Vaxelis); medication errors and exposure during pregnancy for the adjuvanted recombinant respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) pre-fusion F protein vaccine (Arexvy); and hypersensitivity and nonspecific gastrointestinal symptoms for RZV (Shingrix). Fewer deaths were reported following vaccination in 2024 (28 reports) than in 2023 (34 reports). None of the 28 reported deaths in 2024 indicated an emerging safety signal.

analysis.research_question_and_background: This report addresses the need to monitor adverse events following immunisation (AEFI) to ensure vaccine safety, particularly for respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) vaccines. The study aimed to evaluate the safety profile of vaccines administered in 2024, with a focus on RSV-related adverse events.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study is a national surveillance report conducted in Australia during 2024, encompassing all vaccines administered in the country. It includes data from the Therapeutic Goods Administration (TGA) on adverse events reported across the population.
analysis.methods: AEFI data were collected through spontaneous reporting to the TGA and analysed continuously and annually to identify new safety concerns or changes in known safety issues. The analyses focused on the frequency and types of adverse events associated with vaccines, including RSV vaccines.
analysis.main_results: In 2024, there were 6,232 AEFI reports for vaccines administered, with RZV (Shingrix) associated with the highest number of reported AEFIs. The most frequently reported adverse events were medication errors, hypersensitivity, gastrointestinal nonspecific symptoms, pyrexia, and injection site reactions.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret that the slight increase in AEFI reporting rates in 2024 was likely due to the introduction of the new recombinant zoster vaccine (RZV) and the expansion of the eligible population for zoster vaccination. This finding highlights the importance of monitoring new vaccines for safety signals.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform the ongoing surveillance of vaccine safety, particularly for RSV vaccines, and support the need for continued monitoring of adverse events to ensure public health safety and improve vaccine programs.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on spontaneous reporting, which may introduce bias and underreporting. The evidence is moderate as it relies on observational data rather than controlled experiments, and the interpretation is grounded in the observed trends.

analysis.summary_en: This study reports on adverse events following immunisation (AEFI) in Australia for all vaccines administered in 2024. It highlights that RZV (Shingrix) was associated with the highest number of AEFI reports, with medication errors, hypersensitivity, gastrointestinal symptoms, pyrexia, and injection site reactions being the most frequently reported. The authors suggest that the slight increase in AEFI rates compared to 2023 may be attributed to the introduction of RZV and the expanded eligible population for zoster vaccination. The findings underscore the importance of continuous vaccine safety monitoring and provide insights into the safety profile of RSV vaccines. However, the study's reliance on spontaneous reporting introduces potential biases, and the evidence is considered moderate in strength.
